participants: 10–15 ECS staff or students aged 18 or over
sequence: Optional printed copies of own cards without others’ replies
ai: Prepared and checked before sessions. Researcher manually switches examples and assembles cards.
data: A selected source-detail and prepared-image references
B original text, replies, clarifications, source/image references and reply links
questions: Which prototype should we develop further for a museum experience? Tick one.
A: As you arranged materials and compared the source with AI cuff/bag previews, what kept or changed what felt authentic? Why?
B: How did your words, the AI image and others' replies affect what you expressed or understood across cultural perspectives?
Why did you choose that option, and what would you improve, including the postcard wall or take-away?
storage: Local wall restricted to study participants. Locked paper forms and University-approved secure UK digital storage.
retention: At least 10 years after collection or publication, whichever is later, then review disposal.
withdrawal: Skip or discard drafts before submission. Submitted anonymous cards and forms cannot be located for removal.
museum_stage: Later museum fieldwork requires a separate detailed plan.
